verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic reach dropped sharply in the last week.
narrative: No paid ads ran on Meta or Google this period, so all activity came from your Google Business Profile and website. Your Google Business Profile delivered 43 actions over the 28 days — directions, web clicks, and calls — but that engagement fell 88% in the last 7 days compared to the prior 7, a drop that is being investigated now. Website sessions were steady overall, with 205 visits from 166 users this period, and a one-day spike on September 1st that appears to be an isolated referral rather than a new trend. Before paid campaigns are reactivated, intake tracking is being confirmed end-to-end so that every lead is captured and counted from day one.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period (directions, web clicks, and calls)
website sessions in the last 28 days
drop in Google Business Profile engagement over the last 7 days versus the prior 7

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement collapsed in the final week of this period, with zero actions recorded on the last three days.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing local search visibility now to identify the cause — whether a listing issue, a ranking shift, or seasonal demand — and will have findings before the next report.
